lines.english: One look at that face told me there was no chance I would be satisfied with only once.

lines.japanese:
俺は、雪菜をしっかりと抱きしめて、
しばらくその表情を見ないように努力するしかなかった。
lines.english: So I held Setsuna tight and did my best not to look at her for a while.
